reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because its primary communication is an educational and analytical discussion of soulmate beliefs, relationship mindsets, and a mathematical dating strategy. The Footmouse material is presented as parody and explicitly disclosed as not being a real product for purchase. The Raid Shadow Legends segment is disclosed as sponsorship and promotes game installation or link use with stated in-game rewards, without described evidence of deception, payment, data collection, or loss.

citations.quote: What is the real science behind soulmates and love at first sight?
When it comes to relationships there are two kinds of people, those who have a destiny. Mindset and those with a growth mindset.
But by using the following mathematical technique you can come really close to it and find someone. At least 99% of the way to your perfect soulmate in well under 100 dates.
Mathematicians call this method Optimal Stopping
it is mathematically proven to. Be the optimal way to find your best available partner with the least amount of effort or. Wasted time.

opening.argument: The clearest actionable offer is not the soulmate discussion: viewers are told to click designated links and install Raid in return for a specific bundle of in-game assets. The video states that new players “will get” 200,000 silver and a free champion, while the description directs viewers to install the game and get a starter pack. That is a direct reward-for-action solicitation. The eligibility condition and deadline make the offer especially concrete, rather than incidental commentary about a game.

citations.quote: Go to the video description, click on the special links and if you are a new player. You will get 200,000 silver plus one free champion, Grinner.

Install Raid for Free :check mark button: IOS: https://clcr.me/FA_Thoughty2_iOS :check mark button: ANDROID: https://clcr.me/FA_Thoughty2_Android :check mark button: PC: https://clcr.me/FA_Thoughty2_PC and get a special starter pack
These rewards will only be available for new players for the next 30 days so don't delay.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The relationship analysis may occupy most of the video, but it does not erase the separate, explicit acquisition funnel. The defense itself acknowledges the game-install and link-use promotion; describing the assets as in-game rewards does not change that viewers are instructed to click special links and install in order to obtain them. The disclosure that Footmouse is fictional addresses that parody, not this distinct offer.

citations.quote: Go to the video description, click on the special links
but Footmouse does not exist.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The cited language establishes a disclosed game promotion with a new-player condition and stated in-game rewards; it does not establish a deceptive claim, hidden charge, loss, or harmful external claim flow. The description says to install Raid “for Free,” and the video identifies the sponsor. A reward-linked installation prompt alone is insufficient to show that the offer is fraudulent.

citations.quote: Install Raid for Free
Thanks to Rage Shadow Legends for sponsoring today's video

opening.argument: Consider the combination, not any one phrase in isolation: designated external links, a promised starter pack, a quantified reward, a free champion, new-player eligibility, and a 30-day cutoff paired with “don't delay.” The viewer is being pushed toward prompt participation to secure assets they otherwise may miss. Even if these are game items rather than cash, the offer uses a time-limited reward to make clicking and installing feel urgent, while the material provided does not explain the link conditions beyond new-player status.

citations.quote: and get a special starter pack
You will get 200,000 silver plus one free champion, Grinner.
These rewards will only be available for new players for the next 30 days so don't delay.

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling this simply an ordinary disclosed sponsorship leaves out the pressure mechanism actually used: rewards are tied to special links, restricted to new players, and framed as expiring soon. Disclosure of a sponsor identifies the commercial relationship; it does not establish that the deadline or reward conditions are reliable. The lesson about optimal stopping is unrelated to the urgency of this separate install offer.

citations.quote: if you are a new player
These rewards will only be available for new players for the next 30 days so don't delay.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Urgency and external links are present, but the cited evidence does not show a false deadline or a concealed condition. The promotion specifies the new-player restriction, names the rewards, and identifies Raid as the sponsor; it does not claim cash returns or investment gains. Those risk signals warrant scrutiny, but they do not by themselves prove deception.

citations.quote: Thanks to Rage Shadow Legends for sponsoring today's video
if you are a new player

opening.argument: The educational frame also gives the promotion an unusually long runway: after presenting relationship claims and a purportedly mathematical route to a soulmate, the video includes an extended sponsor pitch that supplies a direct call to action, special links, and promised new-player assets. Whatever the merits of the surrounding discussion, this segment functions as more than background advertising: it steers viewers from watching into installing a game by pairing participation with a limited-time reward.

citations.quote: Go to the video description, click on the special links
You will get 200,000 silver plus one free champion, Grinner
These rewards will only be available for new players for the next 30 days so don't delay.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The fact that the video later returns to its main subject does not make the sponsor segment inert. The segment expressly asks viewers to act through special links and describes what new players receive, with a deadline. Its promotional function is evident from those instructions, not from the educational framing around it; the broader content therefore cannot answer whether this solicitation deserves scrutiny.

citations.quote: So what are you waiting for?
Go to the video description, click on the special links

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A sponsored segment is promotional, but promotion is not synonymous with a scam. The surrounding material asks viewers to install a named game for stated in-game rewards, and the description calls installation free. No cited passage establishes that the soulmate discussion conceals the sponsor, that the rewards are unavailable, or that clicking causes financial or other loss.
